sentences.text: Sam y Nico miran los meses del año en un libro.
sentences.english: Sam and Nico look at the months of the year in a book.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sam, hay doce meses en el año.
sentences.english: Sam, there are twelve months in the year.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Enero, febrero, marzo, abril, mayo, junio, julio, agosto, septiembre, octubre, noviembre, diciembre.
sentences.english: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: That is a lot of new words!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Look, it is easy.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Today is March 3.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And your party?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: My party is on Saturday.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: I am going to be eleven.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And the weather?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What is it like in the months?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: En enero y febrero hace frío y hay viento.
sentences.english: In January and February it is cold and windy.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: En mayo y junio llueve mucho.
sentences.english: In May and June it rains a lot.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: En julio y agosto hay sol y calor.
sentences.english: In July and August there is sun and heat.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: En septiembre y octubre hay mucha lluvia.
sentences.english: In September and October there is a lot of rain.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: En noviembre y diciembre hace frío y hay mucho viento.
sentences.english: In November and December it is cold and very windy.

sentences.text: Sam escribe los meses de la gente que conoce.
sentences.english: Sam writes down the months of the people he knows.
Karla: January 10.
Sofía: February 5.
Mario: March 21.
Nico: April 12.

sentences.text: La mamá de Sam: el 9 de mayo.
sentences.english: Sam's mother: May 9.
Marvin: June 30.
Ana: July 8.
Luis: August 20.
Doña Marta: September 2.
Daniel: October 14.
Sam: November 15.
Kevin: December 24.

sentences.text: Ana escribe un mensaje al equipo con su celular.
sentences.english: Ana writes a message to the team with her cell phone.
Hello, team.

sentences.text: El 12 de abril celebramos el cumpleaños de Nico.
sentences.english: On April 12 we celebrate Nico's birthday.

sentences.text: Los invitamos a la casa de doña Marta a las tres.
sentences.english: We invite you to doña Marta's house at three.
We are going to prepare baleadas.

sentences.text: Doña Marta va a cortar la cebolla, calentar el aceite y freír las tortillas de harina.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is going to cut the onion, heat the oil and fry the flour tortillas.

sentences.text: Hay que poner un poco de sal y crema.
sentences.english: A little salt and cream have to be added.

sentences.text: Antes de la fiesta hay culto.
sentences.english: Before the party there is a service.

sentences.text: Cantamos un himno, una canción y una alabanza.
sentences.english: We sing a hymn, a song and a praise song.

sentences.text: Hay una ofrenda para la clínica.
sentences.english: There is an offering for the clinic.

sentences.text: Favor escribir si venís o no venís.
sentences.english: Please write whether you are coming or not.
Karla writes: "Hi, Ana.
Yes, I am coming.
I will bring a present for Nico."
"God blesses Nico.

sentences.text: Gloria a Dios, el rey del mundo."
sentences.english: Glory to God, the king of the world."
Marvin writes: "Hi, Ana.

sentences.text: El sábado tengo un viaje con el equipo.
sentences.english: On Saturday I have a trip with the team.
I cannot go.
Thanks for inviting me."
Daniel writes: "Maybe.

sentences.text: Kevin tiene tos y una enfermedad pequeña."
sentences.english: Kevin has a cough and a small illness."
"The doctor wrote a prescription.

sentences.text: Kevin toma pastillas y debe cuidar su cuerpo."
sentences.english: Kevin takes pills and must take care of his body."
"If he is better, we will come."
Mr Mario writes: "Yes, I am coming.

sentences.text: Ya no tengo sangre en la nariz.
sentences.english: I no longer have blood in my nose.
I am better."

sentences.text: Sam escribe un mensaje a la señora de la pulpería.
sentences.english: Sam writes a message to the woman at the shop.

sentences.text: Señora: la invito al culto del domingo.
sentences.english: Ma'am: I invite you to the service on Sunday.

sentences.text: Vamos a cantar y a alabar a Dios.
sentences.english: We are going to sing and to praise God.

sentences.text: Después hay comida en la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: Afterwards there is food at doña Marta's house.
Sam

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Ana, ¿qué escribo si no puedo ir?
sentences.english: Ana, what do I write if I cannot go?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: You write: "Thanks, but I cannot."

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: If you are not sure, you write: "Maybe."

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And if I want to go?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: You write: "Yes, I am coming.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Thanks."

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I understand.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: It is easy.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Y siempre tenés que dar las gracias.
sentences.english: And you always have to say thank you.

sentences.text: El sábado, la casa de doña Marta tiene mucha gente.
sentences.english: On Saturday, doña Marta's house has many people.

sentences.text: Llegan Karla, Daniel, Kevin y el señor Mario.
sentences.english: Karla, Daniel, Kevin and Mr Mario arrive.

sentences.text: Kevin ya no tiene tos, y el señor Mario está contento.
sentences.english: Kevin no longer has a cough, and Mr Mario is happy.

sentences.text: Karla trae un regalo para Nico.
sentences.english: Karla brings a present for Nico.
It is a new book.

sentences.text: Doña Marta y Ana cortan, calientan y fríen.
sentences.english: Doña Marta and Ana cut, heat and fry.
There is food for everyone.
First the people sing.

sentences.text: Después todos comen, y los jóvenes bailan.
sentences.english: Afterwards everyone eats, and the young people dance.

sentences.text: Sam da a Nico un libro pequeño.
sentences.english: Sam gives Nico a small book.
It is his present.

sentences.text: Nico mira a todos y dice: "Gracias."
sentences.english: Nico looks at everyone and says: "Thank you."

sentences.text: Todos cantan una canción para Nico.
sentences.english: Everyone sings a song for Nico.

sentences.text: Es la canción de su cumpleaños.
sentences.english: It is his birthday song.

sentences.text: Doña Marta ora y dice: "Dios bendice a Nico."
sentences.english: Doña Marta prays and says: "God blesses Nico."

sentences.text: Luis y Ana hablan con el pastor y con la gente de la iglesia.
sentences.english: Luis and Ana talk with the pastor and the people from church.

sentences.text: La fiesta termina a las seis.
sentences.english: The party ends at six.

sentences.text: Todos regresan a sus casas con pan para el domingo.
sentences.english: Everyone goes back home with bread for Sunday.

sentences.text: Nico está muy feliz con su fiesta y con su familia grande.
sentences.english: Nico is very happy with his party and with his big family.
Nico is happy.

sentences.text: El sábado vamos a celebrar mucho.
sentences.english: On Saturday we are going to celebrate a lot.
Nico says: "Thanks, Sam.
I like to celebrate with everybody.

sentences.text: Mi cumpleaños es una fiesta para todos."
sentences.english: My birthday is a party for everyone."
